svg.title: Six Realms: Byzantine mosaic
svg.desc: Six Realms (1D): the tribes' hex board game laid as a Byzantine mosaic, nineteen hexes in tesserae on a gold ground. Wrymreach is the gold-and-silver centre, the six Thresholds ring it in realm colours, and the twelve homes lie outside; one home has already fallen to the forgetting tide and another is dimming for next round. The player's Sky piece leaps three hexes in a straight line over an enemy toward a Threshold, while the hex the enemy Dark piece threatens is ringed in red.
